answer: Under EigenTrust-style factorization, each identity’s centrality derives from weighted trust paths, with reciprocity-weighted transitivity limiting gains from unsupported endorsements. Reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life, so sustained honest service is required to maintain it. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality and no established corroboration; labels such as reef, ferrous, or juniper cannot supply trust, so it cannot pass consensus.
